source: Severson et al., Nature Energy 4, 383-391 (2019); data.matr.io, CC BY 4.0
resampling: np.interp over record order (linspace(0,1,n) -> linspace(0,1,512)), as CALCE
x_norm: per-segment min-max of the resampled x_raw (CALCE convention)
cond_note: RAW, unscaled 5-vector. step_code 0=charge (fast-charge part only), 1=discharge. C1, C2 in C-rate (1C = 1.1 A), Q1 in % SOC. Not the 4-column CALCE/NASA vector.
life_index: true cycle number of the cell (summary 'cycle', 1-based; batch-2 continuation cycles numbered after the batch-1 record)
current_unit: raw I field is in C-rate units (1C = 1.1 A)
